content.text: /ext:medcp For new DOAC users with atrial fibrillation, how often are major-bleeding codes recorded within 30 days?

arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 50 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code, invalid_reason FROM omop.concept WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%atrial fibrillation%' ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, vocabulary_id, concept_name

SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code, invalid_reason FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND standard_concept='S' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%apixaban%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%rivaroxaban%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%dabigatran%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%edoxaban%') ORDER BY concept_name

SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code, invalid_reason FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Condition' AND standard_concept='S' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%gastrointestinal hemorrhage%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%intracranial hemorrhage%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%major bleeding%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%hemorrhage%') ORDER BY concept_name

WITH doac_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_id IN (43013024,45775372,40228152,45892847,40241331)
),
doac_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN doac_ingredients di ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = di.concept_id
),
first_doac AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN doac_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
    GROUP BY de.person_id
),
af_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 313217
),
bleed_ancestors AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (192671, 439847)
),
bleed_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN bleed_ancestors ba ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ba.concept_id
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT fd.person_id, fd.index_date
    FROM first_doac fd
    JOIN omop.observation_period op
      ON op.person_id = fd.person_id
     AND fd.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
     AND DATEADD(day, -365, fd.index_date) >= op.observation_period_start_date
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
        JOIN af_concepts af ON co.condition_concept_id = af.concept_id
        WHERE co.person_id = fd.person_id
          AND co.condition_start_date <= fd.index_date
    )
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS new_doac_users_with_prior_af,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
        JOIN bleed_concepts bc ON co.condition_concept_id = bc.concept_id
        WHERE co.person_id = cohort.person_id
          AND co.condition_start_date >= cohort.index_date
          AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 31, cohort.index_date)
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_major_bleeding_code_30d,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
        JOIN bleed_concepts bc ON co.condition_concept_id = bc.concept_id
        WHERE co.person_id = cohort.person_id
          AND co.condition_start_date >= cohort.index_date
          AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 31, cohort.index_date)
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS percent_with_major_bleeding_code_30d
FROM cohort;

WITH doac_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_id IN (43013024,45775372,40228152,45892847,40241331)
),
doac_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN doac_ingredients di ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = di.concept_id
),
first_doac AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN doac_concepts dc ON de.drug_concept_id = dc.concept_id
    GROUP BY de.person_id
),
af_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 313217
),
bleed_ancestors AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (192671, 439847)
),
bleed_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN bleed_ancestors ba ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ba.concept_id
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT fd.person_id, fd.index_date
    FROM first_doac fd
    JOIN omop.observation_period op
      ON op.person_id = fd.person_id
     AND fd.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
     AND DATEADD(day, -365, fd.index_date) >= op.observation_period_start_date
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
        JOIN af_concepts af ON co.condition_concept_id = af.concept_id
        WHERE co.person_id = fd.person_id
          AND co.condition_start_date <= fd.index_date
    )
),
patient_flags AS (
    SELECT c.person_id, c.index_date,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(co.condition_occurrence_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_major_bleed_30d
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = c.person_id
     AND co.condition_start_date >= c.index_date
     AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 31, c.index_date)
     AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM bleed_concepts)
    GROUP BY c.person_id, c.index_date
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS new_doac_users_with_prior_af,
    SUM(has_major_bleed_30d) AS patients_with_major_bleeding_code_30d,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(has_major_bleed_30d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS percent_with_major_bleeding_code_30d
FROM patient_flags;

content.text:
Among new DOAC users with prior atrial fibrillation, major-bleeding codes were recorded within 30 days for:

- Cohort size: 15,897 patients
- Major bleeding within 30 days: 367 patients
- Rate: 2.31%

I defined DOACs as apixaban, dabigatran/dabigatran etexilate, edoxaban, or rivaroxaban descendants in OMOP; “new” required 365 days of prior observation before first DOAC exposure; AF was any descendant of SNOMED atrial fibrillation; major bleeding was approximated using descendants of gastrointestinal hemorrhage and intracranial hemorrhage.
